Upgrading an identity edge to a 3x3 conv consistently adds useful capacity on all datasets.

Swapping the final-edge 3x3 conv for identity removes learned capacity, whereas replacing a none/weak op is neutral.

- **Downgrading a convolution:** Replacing a conv_3x3 with a cheaper op (skip, 1x1 conv) tends to cost accuracy. Upgrading a skip to a conv tends to help.

Some of these rest on only a few data points, notably hypotheses 6, 9 and 10.
